code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            edge = False
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                if y == 0 or x == 0 or y == h - 1 or x == w - 1:
                    edge = True
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            if not edge:
                boundary = {(y + dy, x + dx) for y, x in cells
                            for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
                            if 0 <= y + dy < h and 0 <= x + dx < w
                            and grid[y + dy][x + dx] != bg}
                minr = min(y for y, x in boundary)
                maxr = max(y for y, x in boundary)
                minc = min(x for y, x in boundary)
                maxc = max(x for y, x in boundary)
                color = 2 if (maxr - minr + 1) % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
